Date July 23 1937.

Subject Re-organization of the Chung Nyi Association.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang

Information has been received that the Fascist
Section of the Central Tangpu of Nanking has become dissatisfied
with Mr. Poo Fung Ming(蒲凤鸣), Mr. Yao Kwang Nai(姚光鼐)
(Police Officers) and other persons who have made blunders in
running the Chung Nyi Association in Shanghai. It is reported
that a re-organization is taking place as a result of which
Messrs Poo and Yao will be removed and deputies appointed
from Nanking to replace them. Rumours are current that
Mr. Liu Hwa(刘槐), Chief Detective of the Police Bureau,
has been named one of the successors but Mr. Liu denies
having received news of the appointment.

CHIN
Tan Shao Liang
Superintendent.

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 5744 37 Date June 17 37）

Subject Chung Nyi Association - establishes new Club in
the Western District
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by Lawrence p.s.l.

The Shanghai Western Branch of the Chung Nyi
Association, 21 Kung Yih Fang, Robison Road, O.O.L., has
established a club at 1264 Brenan Road, O.O.L. The
inaugural meeting of this club was held at 3 p.m. June 13
when some eighty persons including Mr. Yao Kwong-nai
(姚光), Chief of the West Gate Branch of the Shanghai
City Government Police Bureau, who is one of the leaders of
the Chung Nyi Association, were present.

The Chairman of this Club is one named Chang Wen-
siang (张文祥) who is an overseer in the Yung Mou Saw
Mill, 400 Brenan Road, O.O.L. He was formerly the Chairman
of the Shanghai Western Branch of the Chung Nyi Association.

This Club claims to have at present 280 members who
are all workers of various saw mills in the Western District.
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 17 JUNE 1937）
It is learned that the Chairmanship of the Shanghai
Western Branch of the Chung Nyi Association, recently vacated
by Mr. Chang Wen-siang, will be taken over by Mr. Yao Kwong-
nai himself, and that a meeting in his honour will be held
by members of this Branch in its office, Robison Road, O.O.L.
at 2 p.m. June 20.

Sih Tse-liang
C. D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

主题：忠义会 - 在西区建立新俱乐部
由刑事侦缉督察施子良撰写，由 Lawrence p.s.l. 呈报

忠义会上海西区分会（地址：西区越界筑路区罗宾森路公益坊21号）已在西区越界筑路区布伦南路1264号设立一家俱乐部。该俱乐部的成立大会于6月13日下午3时举行，约有八十人出席，其中包括忠义会领导人之一、上海市政府警察局西门分局局长姚光（姚光鼐）先生。

该俱乐部主席名为张文祥，是西区越界筑路区布伦南路400号永茂锯木厂的监工。他曾任忠义会上海西区分会主席。

该俱乐部声称目前拥有280名会员，均为西区各锯木厂的工人。
（印：特别股 上海公共租界工部局警务处 1937年6月17日）
据悉，忠义会上海西区分会主席一职，近期因张文祥先生离职而空缺，将由姚光鼐先生亲自接任，该分会成员将于6月20日下午2时在其办事处（西区越界筑路区罗宾森路）举行会议，以表欢迎。

施子良
刑事侦缉督察

The Shanghai Municipality Chung Nyi Association
(上海市忠義會)

This association which was originally sponsored by the
Whampoa cadets with the object of promoting physical culture,
was formally inaugurated on January 14, 1934 during a meeting
held in the Zao Chi (肇基) Middle School, 135 Brenan Piece,
with a preparatory office at the same address. The then
promoters were Li Tsung Sung (李雲生), an unemployed mill
worker, Woo Sao Ching (何少卿), a school teacher, and Yang Han
Foo (楊漢夫), a member of the Detective Office of the local
Police Bureau. Ostensibly this association which claimed to
have a membership of some 80 persons, aimed at promoting
loyalty and faithfulness among the people.

Nothing of any significance transpired until November
1936 when its membership totalled approximately 300 persons
and included members and ex-members of the Chinese Police,
either attached to Police Headquarters or to the Jessfield
Village Branch Bureau, factory workers in the Western District,
as well as a number of loafers who had become affiliated with
the organization. At this time the offices were located at
21 Kung Yih Faung (公益坊), off Robison Road, O.O.L.

Boo Vung Ming (蒲鳳鳴), the present Chairman of the
Association, who is an Inspector of the Narcotic Section (the 4th
Section) of the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau, has been
appointed liaison officer between the mill workers and the
Shanghai Municipality Textile Workers Mutual Aid Society. He is
assisted in Chung Nyi affairs by Yao Kwang Nai (姚光鼐),
Superintendent-in-Charge, West Gate Branch of the Chinese Police
Bureau, and Chen Yueh (陳越), ex-Inspector attached to the

上海市忠义会

该协会最初由黄埔军校学员发起，旨在提倡体育，于1934年1月14日在布伦小路135号肇基中学举行的会议上正式成立，筹备处也设在该地址。当时的发起人是失业工厂工人李雲生（音译）、学校教师何少卿（音译）以及当地警察局侦探科成员楊漢夫。表面上，该协会声称拥有约80名会员，旨在民众中提倡忠诚和信义。

直到1936年11月之前，未发生任何重大事件，当时其会员总数约为300人，包括隶属于警察总局或极司菲尔路（Jessfield）村分局的中国警察现役及退役人员、西区工厂工人，以及一些依附于该组织的无业游民。此时，办公地点位于西区越界筑路区罗宾森路旁的公益坊21号。

Subject Endeavours being made by Tangpu to close the Chung Nyi Soe which
is displaying unusual interest in labour strikes.
Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

（左侧批注：* See also
Δ. 5704 +
Δ. 7599/31

Δ. 7803）

From what I can gather from Mr. Lee Vee Hsiung (李維熊),
a member of the local Tangpu, the party members are endeavouring
to collect evidence of the unusual interest displayed by the
Chung Nyi Soe in labour disputes, especially its part in
obstructing workers from resuming work contrary to the orders
from Nanking. These reports will be placed before a committee
meeting to decide whether or not to cancel the registration of
the Chung Nyi Soe and to petition Nanking for its suppression
altogether.

This will mean a open battle for labour control between
the Tangpu and the Whampoa Clique. Each side is being backed
up by powerful influence.

主题：党部正努力关闭对罢工表现出异常兴趣的忠义社。
由谭绍良督察长撰写并呈报。

（左侧批注：* 另见
Δ. 5704 +
Δ. 7599/31
Δ. 7693 +
Δ. 7803）

据我从当地党部成员李維熊先生处了解，党员们正努力收集证据，证明忠义社在劳资纠纷中表现出异常兴趣，特别是其阻碍工人违背南京命令复工的行为。这些报告将提交委员会会议，以决定是否取消忠义社的注册，并向南京请愿将其彻底取缔。

这意味着党部与黄埔系之间将为劳工控制权展开公开斗争。双方背后都有强大的势力支持。

August 31, 1934.

Miscellaneous (2)

Chung Nyi Association - Meeting

Some 10 committee members of the Chung Nyi
Association, 135 Brenan Road, which was formed on
January 14, 1934 (Vide I.R. 15/1/34) held a meeting in
their office between 5 p.m. and 6 p.m. August 30 and
decided to present a silver shield to Tan Pao Zeu
(譚保寿), the Chief of the 6th District Police Station,
who, as the result of being promoted, will be transferred
to the Headquarters of the Bureau of Public Safety, as
a token of the esteem in which he was held by
the residents whilst in charge of the 6th District
(Jessfield). At the same time it was also resolved
to arrange a meeting to welcome the new Chief of the
6th District Police Station when he assumes office.

Thos Robertson
Supt.
for Officer i/c Special Branch.

REPORT

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
Branch Station
No. D 5744
Date March 21, 1934.
Date 21 / 3 / 34）

Subject (in full)...... Shanghai Municipality Chung Nyi Association
- receives threatening letter from communists.

Made by... D.S.... Mac Adie .................... Forwarded by... W Loucau DSS

It is learned that the Shanghai Municipality
Chung Nyi Association, 153 Jessfield Road, O.O.L. has recently
received a threatening letter purporting to have emanated
from a certain communistic body. The document apart from
warning the Association against the alleged anti-communist
activities of Yang Dah Ziang (楊大祥) and Sung Chien-ming
(孫劍明), two committee members, urges the latter to quit
the Association at once.

It is reported that following the receipt of the
letter, Yang Dah-ziang who is an inspector of the Bureau of
Public Safety, departed for Nanking on Saturday, March 17.

The majority of the members of the Association are
Tangpu members while a number of detectives of the Bureau of
Public Safety and their seconds as well as loafers are also
affiliated to the organization. There is a strong suspicion
that the Association is a "Blue Shirt" organ.

R. W. Mac adie.
D. S.

（批：Juli
10/2）
Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称）...... 上海市忠义会 - 收到共产党人的恐吓信。

由... D.S.... Mac Adie 撰写 .................... 由... W Loucau DSS 呈报

据悉，位于西区越界筑路区极司菲尔路153号的上海市忠义会最近收到一封恐吓信，据称来自某个共产主义团体。该文件除了警告该协会注意两名委员楊大祥和孫劍明所谓的反共活动外，还敦促后者立即退出该协会。

据报道，收到信件后，身为公共安全局督察的楊大祥于3月17日星期六前往南京。

该协会大多数成员为党部成员，同时也有多名公共安全局的侦探及其副手以及无业游民隶属于该组织。人们强烈怀疑该协会是“蓝衣社”的机构。

R. W. Mac adie.
D. S.

（批：Juli
10/2）
特别股主管警官。

上海市忠义会 - 委员会委员就职。

1月14日任命的上海市忠义会委员会委员的就职宣誓仪式，于2月25日下午2时在该会位于极司菲尔路135号兆差中学的办事处举行。

pages.en:
Extract from Intelligence Report 15.1.34.
:
Shanghai Municipality Chung Nyi Association -
formally inaugurated

The Shanghai Municipality Chung Nyi Association,
which came into existence recently with offices in the
Zao Chi Middle School, 135 Brenan Piece was formally
inaugurated at a meeting held in the school between 11 a.m.
and 1.30 p.m. January 14. During the proceedings an
executive committee of 15 persons and a supervisory committee
of seven members were appointed. Following the inauguration
theatrical performances were staged which lasted till 10p.m.
Some 300 persons attended.
pages.zh:
摘自1934年1月15日的情报报告。
：
上海市忠义会 -
正式成立

上海市忠义会最近成立，办公地点设在布伦小路135号肇基中学，于1月14日上午11时至下午1时30分在该校举行的会议上正式成立。会议期间，任命了由15人组成的执行委员会和由7人组成的监察委员会。成立仪式后上演了戏剧表演，一直持续到晚上10点。约有300人出席。

pages.en:
Extract from Intelligence Report 11.1.34.
-:-

Shanghai Municipality Chung Nyi Association - new
body formed.

A new organization entitled "Shanghai Municipality
Chung (Loyalty) Nyi (faithfulness) Association" has recently
come into existence with a preparatory office in the Zao Chi
(肇基) Middle School, 135 Brenan Piece. The promoters are
Li Tsung Sung (李春生), unemployed mill worker, Woo Sao
Ching (伍少卿), School teacher, Yang Han Foo (楊漢夫), a
member of the Detective Office of the Bureau of Public
Safety. The Association which aims at promoting loyalty
and faithfulness among people claims to have a membership of
about 80 persons.

At a meeting held by some 12 members of the Association
in their office, between 12 noon and 1 p.m. January 10, it
was secided to hold an augural meeting on the afternoon of
January 14 in the Zao Chi School, Brenan Piece, when
theatricals will be staged.
pages.zh:
摘自1934年1月11日的情报报告。
-:-

上海市忠义会 - 新团体成立。

一个名为“上海市忠（忠诚）义（信义）会”的新组织最近成立，筹备处设在布伦小路135号肇基中学。发起人是失业工厂工人李春生（音译）、学校教师伍少卿（音译）以及公共安全局侦探科成员楊漢夫。该协会旨在民众中提倡忠诚和信义，声称拥有约80名会员。

1月10日中午12时至下午1时，该协会约12名成员在其办事处举行会议，决定于1月14日下午在布伦小路肇基中学举行成立大会，届时将上演戏剧。
